testCases.title: Verify contact form accessibility
expectedResults: The contact form is accessible and displayed.

testCases.title: Ensure required fields are displayed
steps: Check for the presence of First name, Last name, Email, Subject, and Message fields.
expectedResults: All required fields (First name, Last name, Email, Subject, Message) are displayed.

testCases.title: Validate subject dropdown options
expectedResults: The subject dropdown contains the specified options.

testCases.title: Check validation for short messages
steps: Enter a message with fewer than 50 characters.
expectedResults: A validation error is shown for the message input.

testCases.title: Confirm submission response
steps: Fill in all required fields with valid data.
